records.title: DR current model range
records.notes: The official DR range lists DR 1.0 EV, DR 3, DR 5, DR 6.0, DR 6.0 powertrain versions, DR 7.0 PHEV and DR PK8. Model-level records keep powertrain labels below the canonical model boundary.

records.title: Sportequipe current technical range
records.notes: Official Sportequipe technical pages identify the numbered model range. Exact engines, bodies and trims remain separate generation/variant work.
